set(TOW1_PROFILE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")

# The full AOT corpus is generated by the root psp_recomp tool. It is checked
# into the profile so a clean configure does not require the game executable.
file(GLOB TOW1_GENERATED CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${TOW1_PROFILE_DIR}/generated/*.cpp")
if(NOT TOW1_GENERATED)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "tow-1 generated corpus is empty. Run:\n"
        "  out/framework/psp_recomp.exe profiles/tow-1/game/eboot.dec "
        "--auto profiles/tow-1/generated 0x08804000 0x2000")
endif()

add_executable(Tow1Native
    host/main.cpp
    host/tow1_hle.cpp
    host/tow1_mpeg.cpp
    host/tow1_atrac.cpp
    host/tow1_ge.cpp
    host/tow1_window.cpp
    host/ge/ge_renderer.cpp
    host/ge/vcs_stubs.cpp
    ${TOW1_GENERATED})

target_include_directories(Tow1Native PRIVATE
    "${TOW1_PROFILE_DIR}/host"
    "${TOW1_PROFILE_DIR}/host/ge"
    "${TOW1_PROFILE_DIR}/generated")

# FFmpeg is used only by the profile's PSMF/MPEG player.  The shared LGPL
# build from WinGet includes import libraries and DLLs; set FFMPEG_ROOT to
# override auto-detection (a separate install or a custom build).
set(FFMPEG_ROOT "" CACHE PATH "FFmpeg installation root")
if(NOT FFMPEG_ROOT)
    if(DEFINED ENV{FFMPEG_ROOT})
        set(FFMPEG_ROOT "$ENV{FFMPEG_ROOT}")
    else()
        file(GLOB _ffmpeg_headers
            "$ENV{LOCALAPPDATA}/Microsoft/WinGet/Packages/BtbN.FFmpeg*/*/include/libavcodec/avcodec.h")
        if(_ffmpeg_headers)
            list(GET _ffmpeg_headers 0 _ffmpeg_header)
            get_filename_component(_ffmpeg_include "${_ffmpeg_header}" DIRECTORY)
            get_filename_component(_ffmpeg_include "${_ffmpeg_include}" DIRECTORY)
            get_filename_component(FFMPEG_ROOT "${_ffmpeg_include}" DIRECTORY)
        endif()
    endif()
endif()

find_path(FFMPEG_INCLUDE_DIR libavcodec/avcodec.h HINTS "${FFMPEG_ROOT}/include")
find_library(FFMPEG_AVFORMAT_LIBRARY avformat HINTS "${FFMPEG_ROOT}/lib")
find_library(FFMPEG_AVCODEC_LIBRARY avcodec HINTS "${FFMPEG_ROOT}/lib")
find_library(FFMPEG_AVUTIL_LIBRARY avutil HINTS "${FFMPEG_ROOT}/lib")
find_library(FFMPEG_SWSCALE_LIBRARY swscale HINTS "${FFMPEG_ROOT}/lib")
find_library(FFMPEG_SWRESAMPLE_LIBRARY swresample HINTS "${FFMPEG_ROOT}/lib")
if(NOT FFMPEG_INCLUDE_DIR OR NOT FFMPEG_AVFORMAT_LIBRARY OR
   NOT FFMPEG_AVCODEC_LIBRARY OR NOT FFMPEG_AVUTIL_LIBRARY OR
   NOT FFMPEG_SWSCALE_LIBRARY OR NOT FFMPEG_SWRESAMPLE_LIBRARY)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "FFmpeg headers/libraries not found. Set FFMPEG_ROOT to an FFmpeg "
        "shared build containing include/ and lib/.")
endif()

target_include_directories(Tow1Native PRIVATE "${FFMPEG_INCLUDE_DIR}")
target_link_libraries(Tow1Native PRIVATE
    psprecomp_core
    "${FFMPEG_AVFORMAT_LIBRARY}"
    "${FFMPEG_AVCODEC_LIBRARY}"
    "${FFMPEG_AVUTIL_LIBRARY}"
    "${FFMPEG_SWSCALE_LIBRARY}"
    "${FFMPEG_SWRESAMPLE_LIBRARY}")

if(WIN32 AND FFMPEG_ROOT AND EXISTS "${FFMPEG_ROOT}/bin")
    file(GLOB FFMPEG_RUNTIME_DLLS "${FFMPEG_ROOT}/bin/*.dll")
    if(FFMPEG_RUNTIME_DLLS)
        add_custom_command(TARGET Tow1Native POST_BUILD
            COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
                ${FFMPEG_RUNTIME_DLLS} "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:Tow1Native>"
            COMMENT "Copying FFmpeg runtime DLLs")
    endif()
endif()
psprecomp_enable_host_avx(Tow1Native)

if(MSVC)
    target_compile_definitions(Tow1Native PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
    target_compile_options(Tow1Native PRIVATE /W4 /EHsc ${PSPRECOMP_MSVC_MP_FLAG})

    if(PSPRECOMP_GENERATED_OPT_LEVEL STREQUAL "0")
        set(TOW1_GENERATED_OPT "/Od")
    elseif(PSPRECOMP_GENERATED_OPT_LEVEL STREQUAL "3")
        set(TOW1_GENERATED_OPT "/Ox")
    else()
        set(TOW1_GENERATED_OPT "/O${PSPRECOMP_GENERATED_OPT_LEVEL}")
    endif()
    # /Ob0 for the first bring-up: measured peak was ~166 MB on the largest
    # unit. Raise the inline level only for units that prove safe.
    set_source_files_properties(${TOW1_GENERATED} PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS
        "${TOW1_GENERATED_OPT};/Ob0;/bigobj;/EHsc;/W0;${PSPRECOMP_MSVC_MP_FLAG}")
else()
    target_compile_options(Tow1Native PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
    set_source_files_properties(${TOW1_GENERATED} PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS
        "-O2;-g0")
endif()

set_target_properties(Tow1Native PROPERTIES
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin"
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELEASE "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin"
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELWITHDEBINFO "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin")
